cuts.head: turn_side
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — kneeling on the ground; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — standing; a small amateur astronomy club's indoor planetarium after a rehearsal — she removes an oversized lightweight foam planet prop from her lap; a silent zero-gravity recreation chamber on an orbital station — she playfully redirects the floating soft ball with one open palm; an archery range of targets on a green field — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — sitting on the ground; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing; the entryway of her home with a shoe bench — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a night-train sleeper compartment with a narrow berth — standing; a walkway through a forest dome inside a colony ship — standing; a maintenance shed with a long workbench — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — brings a cup to her lips
